title: Manual Thirdparty Cloning into runtime/thirdparty/
description: Running git clone, curl, or wget to manually place thirdparty libraries into runtime/thirdparty/. This bypasses setup.ps1 which handles version pinning, .git cleanup, junk removal, patch application, and verification. Manual clones create inconsistent state, wrong versions, and missing patches.
whenToUse: When reviewing any PR or agent action that touches runtime/thirdparty/. When adding new dependencies.
